hooks.name: E2E Completion Gate
hooks.description: Prevents the agent from stopping mid-task. Forces completion of the full pipeline (generate, train, measure, compare, commit) before declaring done.

action.prompt: Before stopping: verify the task is COMPLETE end-to-end. Check: (1) Did the run produce a final measured result? (2) Are there open questions you could answer yourself? (3) Is there a next step you said you'd do but didn't? (4) Did you hit a wall and stop instead of trying the obvious fix? If ANY of these are YES, you are NOT done — continue working. Do not ask the user permission. Do not suggest they run something. Do not say "want me to..." — just DO IT. The only valid stop is: final measurement produced, compared to baseline, disposition written, files committed.
